title: The watchtower
goals: Do not let Dask see you.
Ask whether Dask can see you.
starting_code:
# Dask is standing in the gallery.
# Ask the computer what he is looking at, then sneak past him.
hints: First, ask the computer to print which way Dask is facing.
Next, ask the computer to print if Dask can see your wizard.
Finally, move all the way to the right.
intro: Look, {wizard}, it is Dask. He is staring at the wall. Let us ask if he can see us before we walk past him.
outro: Phew. We made it past him. The computer gave us the right answers.
learned: Now you know what an expression is, and how to ask one whose answer is `True` or `False`.
